ENGAGEMENT APPROACH:
Since 2007, we participate in the CDP. 
We respond to individual shareholder requests as they 
arise, and we hold annual governance and ESG calls with 
top shareholders.
FY19 INTERACTIONS:
We participated in the CDP for the eleventh year, and 
achieved an A- for our investor score and a B- for water use. 
We presented CSR issues to shareholders holding 26% 
in aggregate of our common stock during the company’s 
annual outreach meetings. Topics covered included: 
societal impacts of AI, diversity and inclusion, and Board 
involvement in CSR.
